viewport.why: 480 by 1040 of CSS at three times scale. Shooting these at 360 by 780 at four times scale was tried for one capture — same 1440 by 3120, and a width both phones actually have — and it broke the hero: the brief asks for at least eight notes visible in 02_chat.png with no tear id repeated, and a 360 point thread has a 501 point viewport that holds four. At 480 it holds eight, five of them on torn sheets, five distinct. The phone's width is where the five clips are shot and is what found the truncations and the wrong module row costs this cycle — those fixes all stay — but the still that the material row is judged on at three hundred per cent has to hold what the brief asks it to hold.
